events.text: Marape was elected as alternate Prime Minister.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was elected as alternate Prime Minister on 7th of May 2019 .

events.text: The Ombudsman Commission recommended a leadership tribunal to judge ONeill and Marape on the UBS loan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On the 17th of May the Ombudsman Commission recommended a leadership tribunal to judge ONeill and Marape

events.text: Marape was replaced as alternate MP by Patrick Pruaitch.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the reason for Marapes replacement as alternate MP by Patrick Pruaitch on 28 of May 2019
